#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353;

struct Matrix {
    ll a[2][2];
    Matrix() {
        a[0][0] = a[1][1] = 1;
        a[0][1] = a[1][0] = 0;
    }
    Matrix(ll a00, ll a01, ll a10, ll a11) {
        a[0][0] = a00;
        a[0][1] = a01;
        a[1][0] = a10;
        a[1][1] = a11;
    }
    Matrix(const Matrix& other) {
        memcpy(a, other.a, sizeof(a));
    }
    Matrix operator*(const Matrix& m) const {
        Matrix res;
        res.a[0][0] = (a[0][0] * m.a[0][0] + a[0][1] * m.a[1][0]) % MOD;
        res.a[0][1] = (a[0][0] * m.a[0][1] + a[0][1] * m.a[1][1]) % MOD;
        res.a[1][0] = (a[1][0] * m.a[0][0] + a[1][1] * m.a[1][0]) % MOD;
        res.a[1][1] = (a[1][0] * m.a[0][1] + a[1][1] * m.a[1][1]) % MOD;
        return res;
    }
    Matrix pow(ll exp) const {
        Matrix res;
        Matrix base = *this;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) res = res * base;
            base = base * base;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

ll mod_pow(ll a, ll b) {
    ll res = 1;
    a %= MOD;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ll n, m, L, R;
    scanf("%lld %lld %lld %lld", &n, &m, &L, &R);
    ll cells = n * m;
    if ((n & 1) && (m & 1)) {
        ll total = (R - L + 1) % MOD;
        printf("%lld\n", mod_pow(total, cells));
    } else {
        ll interval = R - L + 1;
        if (interval % 2 == 0) {
            ll allbutone = mod_pow(interval % MOD, cells - 1);
            ll half = (interval / 2) % MOD;
            ll res = (allbutone * half) % MOD;
            printf("%lld\n", res);
        } else {
            ll k = interval / 2;
            Matrix mat(k, k + 1, k + 1, k);
            Matrix res = mat.pow(cells);
            printf("%lld\n", res.a[0][0]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
